text: On Fodor's Language of Thought (Mentalese) hypothesis, what is the relationship between thought and natural language?
choices: Thought occurs in an innate, compositional mental language (Mentalese); natural languages like English merely express thoughts already formed in it
Thought is conducted in one's public natural language, so people who speak different languages literally think differently
Thought has no structure at all until it is put into the words of a natural language
Thinking is the simulation of perceptual and motor experience, with no language-like symbols involved
explanation: For Fodor, Mentalese is prior to and independent of natural language, which is only its vehicle of expression; indeed he argues that learning a natural language presupposes already having concepts. Option 1 is the Sapir-Whorf/relativist view LOT opposes; option 2 is a strong constitutive view of language; option 3 is Barsalou's grounded/simulation alternative.
